messages:
sam: FYI hitting a weird pyright error in the sampleapp when using the async Python client. works at runtime but typecheck fails :grimace:

sam: Repro (very small):
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()

async def main():
    resp = await client.chat.create(model="small", input="hi")
    # pyright thinks resp is Awaitable[ChatResponse] not ChatResponse
    print(resp.output)
```

sam: pyright error: "Call to async function but expected 'ChatResponse' (non-awaitable)" — basically it thinks the function returns a coroutine object instead of being an async function that yields ChatResponse.

anna_dev: Can you paste the exact stub/signature pyright is seeing? which sdk version?

sam: SDK 0.27.1, but this repro also hits on main. pyright traces to the generated stubs in `redwood/_generated/client.pyi`. The signature it shows is: `def create(self, *, model: str, input: str) -> ChatResponse: ...` but at runtime the implementation is `async def create(...) -> ChatResponse:` so pyright complains about mismatch between a non-async stub and an async impl.

mike_l: Ah yeah that matches a bug in the autogen template we recently changed — we generate one set of pyi stubs and reuse them for sync+async clients. For async methods the stub should be `async def` in the pyi (or at least return `Coroutine[Any, Any, ChatResponse]`).

julia_r: Quick options:
- change stub generator to emit `async def` for async client methods (preferred)
- or annotate return type as `-> typing.Coroutine[Any, Any, ChatResponse]` for compatibility

julia_r: Emitting `async def` in .pyi is better for readability and tools. We should also add a small pyright/mypy test to CI for the sampleapp.

sam: I can put up a tiny PR for the template change. plan: detect client flavor when generating stubs and mark methods `async def` in the pyi. will include a test that runs pyright against `samples/python/sampleapp` in CI.

mike_l: SGTM. add a note to changelog for the generator, and update the codegen smoke test so we don't regress. thanks for catching. :+1:

sam: Drafting PR now — linking here once ready. cc @anna_dev for a quick review of the test matrix (pyright + mypy).

ci-bot: nightly-typing-checker job failed on main — 3 errors (see CI run 4892).

anna_dev: will check CI run and mark flakes. if you include a test, please make it opt-in under `devex/typing` suite so we don't slow down everyone.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/2234 — includes generator fix + pyright test + short note in CHANGELOG. thanks all, i'll follow up if CI complains. :wave:
